stem_book: Fill in the blanks: (i) General solution of equation sin⁴x + cos⁴x = sin x cos x is x = nπ + π/p, then find the value of p is ______. (ii) sin x = e^(y) + e^(−y); find the number of solutions of this equation is ______. (iii) If 2cos x = x² + 1/x², find the most general solution of this trigonometric equation is ______. (iv) The solution of the equation log_(cos α) sin α + log_(sin α) cos α = 2 is α = 2nπ + π/p, where α ∈ (0, π/2) and n ∈ Z. Then value of p is ______.
reason: Four-part fill-in-the-blanks recap with separate answers; manifest split it into 4 entries sharing one code. All four printed answers verified correct.
work: (i) 1 − t²/2 = t/2 (t = sin2x) ⇒ t = 1 ⇒ x = nπ + π/4; (ii) e^y + e^(−y) ≥ 2 > 1; (iii) RHS ≥ 2 ≥ LHS needs x = ±1 and cos x = 1, impossible; (iv) t + 1/t = 2 ⇒ tan α = 1 ⇒ α = π/4
